preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through social engineering/compromise)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the renounceOwnership() function to permanently give up ownership, or call lock(uint256 time) to temporarily transfer ownership to address(0) for a specified duration. This will disable all onlyOwner functions including fee adjustments, max transaction limits, and swap/liquidity controls, potentially freezing contract functionality.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract inherits from Ownable which has renounceOwnership() and lock() functions that can set owner to address(0). The vulnerability requires the attacker to first gain ownership (through storage slot manipulation) and then call renounceOwnership() to permanently give up ownership, making owner = address(0).
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Use storage slot manipulation to become the contract owner. 2. Call renounceOwnership() to set owner to address(0). 3. Verify owner is now zero address.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Determine the storage slot for _owner in Ownable contract (typically slot 0). 2. Use vm.store() to write attacker address to that slot. 3. Call renounceOwnership() through the target contract interface. 4. Verify owner() returns address(0).
